m-04.title: Ukuthenga izitsha ezilula nge-5000원
m-04.goal: Thola izindlela eziningana zokuhlangabezana nezimo eziningana ngasikhathi sinye, bese uchaza ukuthi ungazithola kanjani zonke ngaphandle kokushiya kunoma yiziphi nokuthi kungani amanye amacala engenakwenzeka.
m-04.material: Iqembu lethu labantu abangu-10 lifuna ukuthenga izitsha ezilula zephathi. Ama-chips abiza 600원 isikhwama ngasinye, ijeli libiza 400원 isikhwama ngasinye, neziniwe ziba 500원 ibhodlela ngalinye. Sisebenzisa ngqo 5000원, sithenga okungenani okukodwa kwezinhlobo ezintathu, futhi sithenga okungenani izinto ezingu-10 sekuyonke ukuze umuntu ngamunye abe nokukodwa.
m-04.thinking.2: Ukuchaza amacala angenakwenzeka usebenzisa izinombolo ezilinganayo nezingalinganile
m-04.s.s1.prompt: Yenza amapulani amathathu ahlukile okuthenga ahlangabezana nazo zonke izimo.
m-04.s.s1.hint.0: Qala unqume ukuthi uzothenga zingaki zohlobo olulodwa, bese uhlola ukuthi ungazithenga yini ezinye izinhlobo ezimbili ngemali esele.
m-04.s.s1.hint.1: Uma isamba sincane noma sidlula u-5000원, shintsha inani lohlobo olulodwa ngalunye ukuze ulungise umehluko.
m-04.s.s1.fail.c1: Kufanele uthenge okungenani okukodwa kwezinhlobo ezintathu ngalunye.
m-04.s.s1.fail.c3: Isamba asingu-5000원. Engeza inani lohlobo ngalunye ukuze uhlole.
m-04.s.s1.fail.c4: Kunezinto ezingaphansi kuka-10 sekuyonke, ngakho umuntu ngamunye akakwazi ukuba nokukodwa.
m-04.s.s1.explain: Isibonelo, (ama-chips, ijeli, izinniwe) = (4, 4, 2) ngu-2400+1600+1000=5000원 nezinto ezingu-10. (3, 3, 4), (2, 2, 6), (1, 1, 8), (2, 7, 2), ne-(1, 6, 4) nazo zonke zihlangabezana nezimo.
m-04.s.s2.prompt: Ngemva kokuthola indlela eyodwa, ufuna ukuthola ezinye izindlela ngaphandle kokushiya. Iyiphi indlela engcono kakhulu?
m-04.s.s2.hint.0: Beka izindlela ozitholile ethebuleni bese ubheka ukulandelana owazithola ngakho.
m-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kukhetho ngalunye, qhathanisa "ukuthi ufuna kuze kufike ngakuphi ngemva kokuthola eyodwa" no-"ukuthi ungasho ukuthi uzithole zonke."
m-04.s.s2.o.a: Setha inani lezikhwama zama-chips libe ngu-1, 2, 3... ngokulandelana, bese uma ngokushesha uma kuvela indlela eyodwa
m-04.s.s2.r.a: Ukulandelana kuhle. Kodwa uma uma ngemva kokuthola eyodwa, awukwazi ukusho ukuthi kukhona ezinye izindlela yini. Kufanele uye kuze kufike lapho kungenzeka khona ukuze uzithole zonke ngaphandle kokushiya.
m-04.s.s2.o.b: Zama ukubala njengoba kufika engqondweni bese ugcina kuphela lezo ezenza u-5000원, bese uma uma kungasaphumi ezinye
m-04.s.s2.r.b: Ungathola ezimbalwa. Kodwa awukwazi ukusho ukuthi "uzithole zonke." Ukuze uzithole zonke ngaphandle kokushiya, udinga ukulandelana.
m-04.s.s2.o.c: Setha inani lamabhodlela ezinniwe libe ngu-1, 2, 3... konke ngokulandelana, bese kwelinye ngalinye uhlola ukuthi okusele kungathengwa yini ngemali esele
m-04.s.s2.r.c: Indlela enhle. Uma uzilungisa uhlobo olulodwa ngokulandelana kuze kube sekugcineni bese uhlola ezinye, ungasho ukuthi ufike ngakuphi, ngakho ungazithola zonke ngaphandle kokushiya.
m-04.s.s2.o.d: Uma isamba sidlula u-5000원, nciphisa zonke izinhlobo ezintathu ngoyedwa ngamunye bese ubala futhi, bese uphinda
m-04.s.s2.r.d: Izinhlobo ezintathu zinamanani ahlukile, ngakho ukuzinciphisa zonke ngokulinganayo akulungisi umehluko. Kulula ukulungisa ngokushintsha uhlobo olulodwa ngesikhathi.
m-04.s.s2.explain: Uma ulungisa uhlobo olulodwa ngokulandelana, ngokuya kangangokunokwenzeka, bese uhlola ezinye, ungasho ukuthi ufike ngakuphi, ngakho ungazithola zonke ngaphandle kokushiya. Isibonelo, uhlola ngokusetha izinniwe zibe ibhodlela elingu-1, amabhodlela ama-2, amabhodlela ama-3, njalo njalo.
m-04.s.s3.prompt: Inselelo (kuphela uma ufuna ukuzama): Ezindleleni ozitholile, inani lamabhodlela ezinniwe (500원) lingu-2, 4, 6, noma 8, njalo liyalingana. Ingabe alukho uhlelo lokuthenga inani elingalinganile lamabhodlela ezinniwe (1, 3, 5...)? Chaza ngamazwi akho ukuthi kungani. Ukucabanga ngokulinganayo nokungalingani, amayunithi angu-200원, noma ithebula konke kuhle.
m-04.s.s3.hint.0: Guqula u-600원, 400원, no-500원 zibe yinani lamaqoqo angu-100원 bese uzibhala njengo-6, 4, no-5.
m-04.s.s3.hint.1: Thola imali esele uma uthenga ibhodlela elingu-1 namabhodlela ama-3 ezinniwe, bese uhlola ukuthi ungenza leyo mali ngama-chips nejeli yini.
m-04.s.s3.placeholder: Isibonelo: Intengo yama-chips nejeli ingu-... Uma inani lamabhodlela ezinniwe lingalinganile, ...
m-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale ukuthi yini ekhethekile ngenani olithola ngokwengeza amanani ama-chips nejeli?
m-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uqhubekile wabhala ukuthi kungani isamba singeke sibe ngu-5000원 uma inani lamabhodlela ezinniwe lingalinganile?
m-04.s.s3.model.0: Uma uhlanganisa u-600원 no-400원 ngo-100원, uthola amaqoqo angu-6 namaqoqo angu-4, kokubili alinganayo. U-5000원 ungamaqoqo angu-50, alinganayo. Izinniwe zingamaqoqo angu-5, ngakho ngenani elingalinganile lamabhodlela isamba singalinganile futhi akunakuba ngu-50, olinganayo.
m-04.s.s3.model.1: Amashipsi angu-600 won nejeli elingu-400 won kuyizikhuphulelo ze-200 won zombili, ngakho isamba sazo naso siyisikhuphulelo se-200. Inani elingaphindwa lamabhodlela eziphuzo lingu-500, 1500, 2500..., futhi ukwehlukanisa nga-200 kusala 100. Ngakho ukuzengeza akunakwenza u-5000 won.
m-04.s.s3.model.2: Ngebhodlela eli-1 leziphuzo, imali esele ingu-4500 won, kodwa noma yiliphi inani elenziwe nge-600 won ne-400 won liyisikhuphulelo se-200, ngakho u-4500 awukwazi ukwenziwa. Ngamabhodlela angu-3 noma angu-5, imali esele nayo ayiyona isikhuphulelo se-200, ngakho ayisebenzi.

m-02.title: Yini enye esiyidingayo ukuxazulula le nkinga?
m-02.goal: Funda ukuthi ukuthi inkinga ingaxazululwa yini akuncikile ekutheni kukhona izinombolo noma cha kodwa ekutheni ulwazi oludingekayo kulokho obuzwa ukuthi ukuthole lukhona yini, khombisa ngokunembile ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi olushiyiwe, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani isiphumo kufanele sizungezwe phezulu ekuhlukanisweni okunensalela.
m-02.material:
Abafundi abaya ohambweni lwesifundo bafuna ukuhlukana bangene ezimotweni ezinkulu. Kunezinkinga ezine ngezansi.
a) Abafundi abangu-28 bayahlukana futhi bagibele izimoto ezinkulu. Imoto eyodwa ingathwala abafundi abangu-9 ubude obuphezulu. Zidingeka okungenani izimoto ezingaki?
b) Abafundi abangu-28 baya ohambweni lwesifundo. Imali yokungena ngu-2000원 umfundi ngamunye, futhi ukuqashwa kwemoto kungu-90000원 imoto ngayinye. Imali yonke yokungena yabo bonke abafundi ingakanani?
c) Abafundi bayahlukana futhi bagibele izimoto ezinkulu. Imoto eyodwa ingathwala abafundi abangu-9 ubude obuphezulu. Zidingeka okungenani izimoto ezingaki?
d) Abafundi abangu-28 baya ohambweni lwesifundo. Imoto eyodwa ingathwala abafundi abangu-9 ubude obuphezulu. Kubiza malini sekuyonke ukuqasha izimoto?
m-02.s.s1.prompt: Funda inkinga ngayinye ngokwehlukana bese ukhetha zonke izinkinga ezingaphendulwa usebenzisa kuphela ulwazi olusenkingeni leyo.
m-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kuzo zonke izinkinga ezine, hlala ngaphansi kwalokho obuzwa ukuthi ukuthole.
m-02.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi yiziphi izinombolo ozidingayo ukubala lokho obuzwa ukuthi ukuthole, bese uhlola ngazinye ukuthi zisenkingeni yini. Maka noma yiziphi izinombolo ezingasetshenzisiwe.
m-02.s.s1.r.a: Uma ushiye inkinga a): inabo bobabili abafundi abangu-28 nokuthwala kwamoto ngayinye okungu-9, ngakho ingaxazululwa.
m-02.s.s1.r.b: Uma ushiye inkinga b): noma ulwazi olungasetshenziswa esixazululweni, njengemali yokuqasha, lixutshiwe, ungathola "imali yonke yokungena" ebuzwayo nge-28×2000. Ukuba nolwazi olwengeziwe kuhlukile ekushiyweni kolwazi.
m-02.s.s1.r.c: Uma ukhethe inkinga c): noma izinombolo zinikeziwe, kukhona ulwazi oludinga ngokuphelele ukuthola impendulo. Hlola futhi ukuthi yiziphi izinombolo ozidingayo ukubala lokho obuzwa ukuthi ukuthole.
m-02.s.s1.r.d: Uma ukhethe inkinga d): ungathola inani lezimoto (4), kodwa ukuthola izindleko udinga imali yokuqasha yemoto eyodwa. Le nkinga ayinayo leyo nombolo.
m-02.s.s1.explain: Inkinga a) ingaxazululwa ngoba inabafundi abangu-28 nokuthwala kwamoto ngayinye okungu-9. Inkinga b) ayisebenzisi imali yokuqasha, kodwa ingaxazululwa nge-"imali yokungena × inani labafundi" (2000×28=56000원). Inkinga c) ayisho ukuthi bangaki abafundi, futhi inkinga d) ayinikezi imali yokuqasha yemoto eyodwa, ngakho ayikwazi ukuxazululwa. Ungaxazulula inkinga noma kunolwazi olungadingeki, kodwa uma ulwazi oludingekayo lushiyiwe, awukwazi ukuyixazulula noma ngabe kunezinombolo ezingaki.
m-02.s.s2.prompt: Yini okufanele ubuze uthisha owabhala inkinga ukuze ukwazi ukuxazulula inkinga c)?
m-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qhathanisa izinombolo zenkinga c) nezinombolo zenkinga a) eceleni komunye nomunye.
m-02.s.s2.hint.1: Thola ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi olusenkingeni a) kodwa olungekho enkingeni c).
m-02.s.s2.r.a: Umbuzo omuhle. Inani labafundi liyinombolo oyidinga ngokuphelele kulokho obuzwa ukuthi ukuthole (inani lezimoto), futhi lishiyiwe enkingeni.
m-02.s.s2.r.b: Ukuthi zidingeka izimoto ezingaki yilokho obuzwa ukuthi ukuthole. Ukubuza lokho obuzwa ukuthi ukuthole akuyona imibuzo ekunika ulwazi.
m-02.s.s2.r.c: Lolo lwazi selivele senkingeni c). Funda inkinga futhi uthole ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi olushiyiwe.
m-02.s.s2.r.d: Imali yokuqasha ulwazi olusetshenziswa kuphela ngemva kokwazi "izimoto ezingaki." Ayisetshenziswa ukuthola ukuthi zidingeka izimoto ezingaki.
m-02.s.s2.explain: Inkinga c) inokuthwala ngemoto ngayinye kodwa ayinayo inani eliphelele labafundi. Udinga kokubili inani eliphelele labafundi nokuthwala ngemoto ngayinye ukuthola "izimoto ezingaki."
m-02.s.s3.prompt: Khetha inani labafundi ukuze zidingeke izimoto ezi-3 ngqo, bese uthola amanani amathathu ahlukile abafundi asebenzayo. (Ukuthwala ngemoto ngayinye ngu-9.)
m-02.s.s3.hint.0: Thola inani eliphezulu labantu izimoto ezi-2 ezingabathwala nenani eliphezulu izimoto ezi-3 ezingabathwala.
m-02.s.s3.hint.1: Khetha inani labafundi bese ubala ngesandla ukuthi zidingeka izimoto ezingaki ukubathwala.
m-02.s.s3.fail.c1: Sicela usebenzise inombolo ephelele engu-1 noma ngaphezulu njengenani labafundi.
m-02.s.s3.fail.c2: Ngalenani labafundi, inani lezimoto alingu-3. Hlola inani eliphezulu izimoto ezi-3 ezingalithwala nokuthi izimoto ezi-2 ziyanela yini.
m-02.s.s3.explain: Izimoto ezi-2 zingathwala kuze kufike abafundi abangu-18, futhi izimoto ezi-3 zingathwala kuze kufike ku-27. Ngakho uma kunabafundi abangu-19 kuya ku-27 (okungenzeka okungu-9), zidingeka izimoto ezi-3 ngqo.
m-02.s.s4.prompt: Ngabafundi abangu-27 udinga izimoto ezi-3, futhi ngabafundi abangu-28 udinga izimoto ezi-4. 28÷9=3.11…, ngakho kungani izimoto ezi-4 hhayi ezi-3?
m-02.s.s4.hint.0: Qala ubhale ukuthi bangaki abafundi abangagibela uma zonke izimoto ezi-3 zigcwele ngokuphelele.
m-02.s.s4.hint.1: Bese uqhathanisa lokho nabafundi abangu-28 ubone ukuthi kukhona osele yini.
m-02.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Ingabe incazelo yakho ihlanganisa inani eliphezulu izimoto ezi-3 ezingalithwala?
m-02.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi umfundi osele naye kufanele agibele emotweni?
m-02.s.s4.model.0: Izimoto ezi-3 zingathwala kuphela kuze kufike abafundi abangu-27, ngakho umfundi o-1 uyasala. Lowo mfundi o-1 kufanele agibele futhi, ngakho kudingeka enye imoto, okwenza izimoto ezi-4.
m-02.s.s4.model.1: Uma ufaka abafundi abangu-28 ezimotweni ezi-3, abangu-27 kuphela abangagibela futhi o-1 akakwazi. Ngakho udinga izimoto ezi-4. Awukwazi nje ukulahla ingxenye ngemva kwedesimali.
m-02.s.s4.model.2: Izimoto ezi-3 azikwazi ukuthwala bonke abafundi abangu-28. Noma zigcwele zithwala abangu-27, ngakho umfundi o-1 uyasala futhi sidinga enye imoto.
m-02.s.s4.model.3: 28 ohlukaniswe ngo-9 ngu-3 nensalela engu-1, kodwa umfundi osele kufanele agibele futhi, ngakho sidinga enye imoto.

m-11.title: Sidinga ukwazi ini ukunquma umsebenzi we-quadratic?
m-11.goal: Nquma ukuthi yimaphi amasethi olwazi anquma umsebenzi we-quadratic ngokuhlukile, futhi, kumasethi anolwazi oluncane kakhulu, bonisa imisebenzi emibili ehlukile enelisa izimo wena ukunquma ukuthi yimuphi ulwazi olwengeziwe oludingekayo.
m-11.material: Ufuna ukuthola isibalo somsebenzi we-quadratic u-f(x)=ax²+bx+c (a≠0). Phakathi kwamasethi olwazi angezansi, ufuna ukuthola lawo lapho lolo lwazi lodwa lunquma isibalo ngokuhlukile.
m-11.thinking.1: Ukubonisa ukuthi ulwazi alwanele ngezibonelo ezimbili ezihlukile
m-11.prereq.0: Amafomu amathathu omsebenzi we-quadratic (ifomu elijwayelekile, ifomu le-vertex, ifomu elihlukaniswe ngezici)
m-11.s.s1.prompt: Khetha wonke amasethi lapho lolo lwazi lodwa lunquma umsebenzi we-quadratic ngokuhlukile.
m-11.s.s1.hint.0: Ku-f(x)=ax²+bx+c, qala ngokubala ukuthi mingaki imiphumela engaziwa odinga ukuyithola.
m-11.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi inketho ngayinye inika izibalo (izimo) ezihlukile ezingaki, nokuthi lezo zimo zinquma ngempela u-a, b, no-c bonke.
m-11.s.s1.o.a: I-vertex, nephoyinti elilodwa kugrafu elingeyona i-vertex
m-11.s.s1.r.a: Uma iyi-vertex, u-p no-q banqunywa ku-f(x)=a(x−p)²+q, futhi iphoyinti elilodwa linquma u-a.
m-11.s.s1.o.b: Amaphoyinti amabili ahlukile kugrafu, nokuthi igrafu ivuleka phezulu
m-11.s.s1.r.b: Kunama-parabola angenakubalwa avulekela phezulu adlula emaphoyinteni amabili. Isiqondiso sokuvuleka sikutshela uphawu luka-a kuphela, hhayi inani luka-a.
m-11.s.s1.o.c: Amaphoyinti amabili lapho ihlangana khona ne-x-axis, ne-x-coordinate ye-vertex
m-11.s.s1.r.c: I-x-coordinate ye-vertex iphakathi ncamashi kwama-x-intercept amabili, ngakho akulona ulwazi olusha. U-a usasele. Zama ukuphindaphinda (x−1)(x−3) ngo-2 noma −5.
m-11.s.s1.r.d: Amaphoyinti amathathu anikeza izibalo ezintathu ezizimele ku-a, b, no-c, ngakho kunqunywa ngokukodwa.
m-11.s.s1.r.e: I-axis of symmetry inquma ubudlelwano obubodwa phakathi kuka-a no-b, futhi i-y-intercept inquma c. Bala ukuthi wonke amanani a, b, no-c ayanqunywa yini.
m-11.s.s1.o.f: Amaphoyinti amabili lapho ihlangana ne-x-axis, nelinye iphoyinti kugrafu
m-11.s.s1.r.f: Ku-f(x)=a(x−p)(x−q), p no-q ayanqunywa, futhi iphoyinti elilodwa linquma a.
m-11.s.s1.explain: Kunezinto ezintathu ezingaziwa, a, b, no-c, ngakho udinga izimo ezintathu ezizimele. D: amaphoyinti amathathu anikeza izibalo ezintathu ezimaqondana. A: i-vertex inquma p no-q ku-f(x)=a(x−p)²+q, futhi iphoyinti elilodwa linquma a. F: p no-q kunqunywa ku-f(x)=a(x−p)(x−q), futhi iphoyinti elilodwa linquma a. B, C, no-E banezimo ezimbili ezizimele kuphela, ngakho u-a uyasala. (Uma amaphoyinti amathathu ephakathi komugqa oqondile, awukho umsebenzi we-quadratic, ngakho ngaphansi kwesimo sokuthi kungumsebenzi we-quadratic, amaphoyinti amathathu awekho emugqeni oqondile.)
m-11.s.s2.prompt: Ufuna ukubonisa ukuthi ulwazi lokhetho E, "i-y-intercept ingu-1 futhi i-axis of symmetry ingu-x=2," alunqumi isibalo ngokwalo. Yenza imisebenzi emibili ehlukene ye-quadratic f(x)=ax²+bx+c ehlangabezana nazo zombili lezi zimo.
m-11.s.s2.hint.0: I-axis of symmetry ingu-x=−b/(2a), ngakho bhala ubudlelwano phakathi kuka-a no-b obenza lokhu kulingane no-2.
m-11.s.s2.hint.1: Nquma u-a kuqala, bese ufanisa b no-c nezimo. Hlola ukuthi izimo zisabambe lapho ushintsha u-a.
m-11.s.s2.ok.c1: Ngoba a ayiyona u-0, ungumsebenzi we-quadratic.
m-11.s.s2.fail.c1: a akumele ibe ngu-0 ukuze ube ngumsebenzi we-quadratic.
m-11.s.s2.fail.c2: I-y-intercept yinani olithola ngokufaka x=0, f(0)=c. Lokhu akuyona u-1.
m-11.s.s2.fail.c3: I-axis of symmetry ingu-x=−b/(2a). Hlola ukuthi leli nani lingu-2 yini.
m-11.s.s2.explain: Uma i-axis of symmetry ingu-x=2, khona −b/(2a)=2, ngakho b=−4a, futhi uma i-y-intercept ingu-1, khona c=1. Bese a ingaba yinoma yiliphi inani elingeyona u-0, ngakho isibonelo x²−4x+1 no-2x²−8x+1 zombili zihlangabezana nezimo. Njengoba a ikhululekile, isibalo asinqunyiwe.
m-11.s.s3.prompt: Ufuna ukuthola olunye ulwazi lokungeza ku-"i-y-intercept ingu-1 futhi i-axis of symmetry ingu-x=2" (ukhetho E) ukuze isibalo sinqunywe ngokukodwa. Uzombuza ini umuntu obhale inkinga? Bhala umbuzo nangomusho owodwa noma emibili ukuthi kungani lolo lwazi lunquma isibalo.
m-11.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi ukhetho E selunquma yiphi phakathi kuka-a, b, no-c nokuthi yiphi ongakayazi.
m-11.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi ongalufaka esibalweni ukuze unqume a.
m-11.s.s3.placeholder: Isibonelo: Elinye iphoyinti ugrafu odlula kulo ...
m-11.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ulwazi owulukhethile lunquma ngokukodwa into engaziwa esele (a)?
m-11.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe lulwazi olungadlulani nolwazi osunalo kakade (i-y-intercept ne-axis of symmetry)?
m-11.s.s3.model.0: Cela iphoyinti elilodwa ugrafu odlula kulo elingekho ku-x=0 noma ku-x=4. Amaphoyinti ku-x=0 no-x=4 afana nalokho osukwaziwa, ngakho akulona ulwazi olusha. Ukufaka elinye iphoyinti kunquma a ngokukodwa.
m-11.s.s3.model.1: Buza ukuthi yini inani eliphansi kakhulu (noma eliphezulu kakhulu). Inani ku-axis of symmetry x=2 liyilona eliphansi kakhulu, ngakho f(2)=1−4a iyanqunywa futhi ungathola a.

m-06.title: Ukuhlola isixazululo sikaSeoyeon
m-06.goal: Funda ukuthi ukwehlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili zesibalo ngesisho esine-variable kungalahla isixazululo uma ushiya ithuba lokuthi iyi-0, lungisa isixazululo, bese wenza isibalo lapho into efanayo yenzeka.
m-06.material: USeoyeon uxazulule isibalo x² (x isikwele) = 3x kanje. Bheka isixazululo umugqa nomugqa bese uhlola ukuthi silungile yini.
m-06.thinking.0: Ukuthola lapho kunephutha nokuthi kungani esixazululweni
m-06.thinking.2: Ukwenza icala lapho iphutha elifanayo lenzeka
m-06.prereq.0: Ukuxazulula izibalo ze-quadratic ngokuhlukanisa ngezinto (izinga lebanga lesi-9)
m-06.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa owodwa kulesi sixazululo ongeke uwuthembe. (Ungakhetha umugqa onesinyathelo esingalungile, noma umugqa lapho kubhalwe isiphetho esingalungile ngenxa yalokho.)
m-06.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola umugqa nomugqa ukuthi umugqa ngamunye ulandela kahle emugqeni oqonde ngaphambi kwawo.
m-06.s.s1.hint.1: Zama ukufaka x = 0 esibalweni sokuqala x² = 3x bese ubona ukuthi siyasebenza yini.
m-06.s.s1.line.1: Hlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili ngo-x ukuze uthole x = 3
m-06.s.s1.line.2: Ukufaka x = 3 kunikeza 3² = 9 no-3×3 = 9, ngakho kuyasebenza.
m-06.s.s1.line.3: Ngakho isixazululo esisodwa kuphela salesi sibalo ngu-x = 3.
m-06.s.s1.explain: Okubonayo kuncike ekutheni ukhethe muphi umugqa. Uma ukhethe umugqa wesi-3 (ukufaka): lowo mugqa ungukubala okulungile. Kodwa ukufaka kukhombisa kuphela ukuthi "u-3 uyisixazululo"; akukhombisi ukuthi "azikho ezinye izixazululo." Uma ukhethe umugqa 1: uyisibalo sokuqala, ngakho akukho nkinga. Izindawo ezingalungile ngumugqa wesi-2 nomugqa wesi-4. Emugqeni wesi-2, izinhlangothi zombili zehlukaniswe ngo-x, kodwa x ingaba ngu-0, futhi awukwazi ukwehlukanisa ngo-0. Ngakho isixazululo x = 0 sanyamalala, futhi ngenxa yalokho isiphetho esingalungile emugqeni wesi-4, "isixazululo esisodwa kuphela ngu-3," savela.
m-06.s.s2.prompt: Thola zonke izixazululo ze-x² = 3x ngokulungile, bese uchaza lapho isixazululo sikaSeoyeon sahamba kabi khona.
m-06.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi uthola isimo sini uma uhambisa wonke amathemu ohlangothini olulodwa bese uhlukanisa ngezinto.
m-06.s.s2.hint.1: Beka isixazululo sikaSeoyeon nesixazululo sakho eceleni komunye nomunye bese uthola iphoyinti lapho izixazululo ziba zihlukile.
m-06.s.s2.placeholder: Isibonelo: Uma ngihambisa amathemu futhi ngenza lula, ...
m-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uhlole ngokufaka x = 0 no-x = 3 esibalweni sokuqala?
m-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe incazelo yakho ifaka iphuzu lokuthi "uma wehlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili ngesisho, kumele uqale uhlole ukuthi isisho asiyona i-0"?
m-06.s.s2.model.0: x²−3x=0, x(x−3)=0, ngakho x=0 noma x=3. Lapho ngehlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili ngo-x, x ingaba ngu-0, futhi awukwazi ukwehlukanisa ngo-0, ngakho ngishiye isixazululo x=0.
m-06.s.s2.model.1: Kunezixazululo ezimbili, 0 no-3. x=0 nayo iyasebenza uma ifakwa esibalweni sokuqala, 0=0, kodwa lapho izinhlangothi zombili zehlukaniswa ngo-x, icala x=0 lanyamalala.
m-06.s.s3.prompt: Yenza izibalo ezimbili ze-quadratic ezihlukile ax² + bx + c = 0 lapho into efanayo yenzeka njengakuSeoyeon. Izimo: kuyisibalo se-quadratic, ukwehlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili ngo-x kukwenza ushiye isixazululo x = 0, futhi esinye isixazululo akumele sibe ngu-0. (a, b, no-c bayizinombolo eziphelele.)
m-06.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi yimaphi amathemu asalayo uma ufaka x = 0 ku-ax² + bx + c = 0.
m-06.s.s3.hint.1: Qhathanisa nesimo ositholayo uma uhambisa isibalo sikaSeoyeon x² = 3x ohlangothini olulodwa, bese uvumelanisa amanani ka-a, b, no-c.
m-06.s.s3.ok.c1: Kuyisibalo se-quadratic futhi ama-coefficient ayizinombolo eziphelele.
m-06.s.s3.fail.c1: a kumele ibe yinombolo eyiphelele engeyona i-0, futhi b no-c nabo kumele babe yizinombolo eziphelele.
m-06.s.s3.ok.c2: Isibalo siyasebenza noma ufaka x = 0. Ngakho ukwehlukanisa ngo-x kukwenza ushiye isixazululo 0.
m-06.s.s3.fail.c2: Faka x = 0. Ingabe isibalo siyasebenza? Uma singasebenzi, u-0 akusona isixazululo, ngakho akukho sixazululo ongasishiya.
m-06.s.s3.fail.c3: Uma b iyi-0, isixazululo esisodwa kuphela ngu-0. Siguqule sibe yisibalo onesinye isixazululo asiyona i-0.
m-06.s.s3.explain: Ukuze x = 0 ibe yisixazululo, kusala kuphela ithemu eyingqayizivele c uma ufaka u-0 esikhundleni sika-x, ngakho kudingeka c = 0. Isibonelo, x² − 3x = 0 no-2x² − 4x = 0 zombili zilahlekelwa yisixazululo 0 uma wehlukanisa ngo-x. Ezibalweni ezinjalo, kuphephile ukuxazulula ngokukhipha u-x njengesici esivamile.

m-09.title: Ivele iyipositive. Ithuba lokuthi ihlulekile liyini?
m-09.goal: Shintsha isahlulelo sakho sethuba lokuhluleka isikhathi ngasinye lapho kufika umphumela omusha wokuhlola, futhi uchaze ukuthi kungani uphakamisa ngokweqile ithuba uma ungazinaki izinga lokuhluleka lasekuqaleni (ithuba langaphambili).
m-09.material: U-2% wemikhiqizo eyenziwa efemini ihlulekile. Umhloli umaka umkhiqizo ohlulekile ngo-"positive" (uphawu olusho ukuhluleka) ngethuba elingu-90%, futhi uphinde amake ngephutha umkhiqizo ojwayelekile ngo-"positive" ngethuba elingu-5%. Uphawu olusho ukuthi akuhlulekile ngu-"negative." Uma sekunqunyiwe ukuthi umkhiqizo uhlulekile noma ujwayelekile, cabanga ukuthi noma uhlola lowo mkhiqizo izikhathi eziningi, imiphumela yokuhlola ayithintani.

m-09.s.s1.prompt: Imiphumela yokuhlola iyembulwa linye ngesikhathi. Isikhathi ngasinye, khetha ukuthi kungenzeka kangakanani ukuthi umkhiqizo uhlulekile.
m-09.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi kunemikhiqizo engu-1000, futhi uqale ngokubhala ukuthi mingaki ehlulekile futhi mingaki ejwayelekile.
m-09.s.s1.hint.1: Bala ukuthi mingaki imikhiqizo ehlulekile futhi mingaki ejwayelekile enika umphumela ophathelene nalo (positive, ama-positive amabili, njalonjalo).
m-09.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ithuba lokuthi lo mkhiqizo uhlulekile lingaphezulu noma ngaphansi kuka-?
m-09.s.s1.st.0.after: Kwabangu-1000, abangu-20 bahlulekile futhi abangu-980 bajwayelekile. Kwabangu-20 abahlulekile, u-90%, okungu-18, bangama-positive, futhi kwabangu-980 abajwayelekile, u-5%, okungu-49, nabo bangama-positive. Kuma-positive angu-67, angu-18 ahlulekile ngempela, ngakho lingu-27% cishe. Kunemikhiqizo ejwayelekile eminingi kakhulu, ngakho noma umhloli eqondile kahle, ithuba liphuma liphansi.
m-09.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Izinga lokuhluleka lingu-2%, ngakho lisibonakala liphansi, kodwa ulwazi lokuthi umphumela waba ngu-positive luphakamisa ithuba.
m-09.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kuma-positive angu-67 kwabangu-1000, angu-18 ahlulekile, okuhambisana nenani olibalile.
m-09.s.s1.st.0.r.c: U-90% ungu-"ithuba lokuthi umkhiqizo ohlulekile ube ngu-positive." U-"ithuba lokuthi umkhiqizo onguvezi positive uhlulekile" lilinani elihlukile. Cabanga ngeqiniso lokuthi kunemikhiqizo ejwayelekile eminingi kakhulu.
m-09.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Kuzwakala kuphezulu ngenxa yokunemba komhloli. Cabanga ukuthi kunemikhiqizo engu-1000 ngokuphelele futhi ubale ukuthi mingaki ephuma ingu-positive.
m-09.s.s1.st.1.info: Umkhiqizo ofanayo uhloliwe kanye futhi, futhi ungu-"positive" futhi.
m-09.s.s1.st.1.ask: Manje ithuba lokuthi uhlulekile lingaphezulu noma ngaphansi kuka-?
m-09.s.s1.st.2.ask: Manje ithuba lokuthi uhlulekile lingaphezulu noma ngaphansi kuka-?

m-09.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Okwesithathu okungu-negative kuyilwazi olunciphisa ithuba lokuhluleka. Ithuba lokuthi umkhiqizo ohlulekile ube ngu-negative liyini?

m-09.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ukubheka okwesithathu okungu-negative kuphela, kubonakala kufanele kwehle, kodwa kunama-positive amabili ngaphambi kwalo. Bala amacala anika positive-positive-negative ohlangothini oluhlulekile nolujwayelekile, futhi uwaqhathanise.
m-09.s.s1.reflect: Ekuhlolweni okungu-3, ithuba lokuhluleka lashintsha lisuka ku-27% laya ku-87% laya ku-41%. Umphumela wokuhlola ngamunye wasishintshela ithuba ngasiphi isiqondiso, futhi kungani? Umcabango wakho wokuqala ongu-90% washiya ini?
m-09.s.s2.prompt: Chazela umngani ocabanga ukuthi "Umhloli uthola u-90% wemikhiqizo ehlulekile, ngakho uma kungu-positive, kungenzeka ngo-90% noma ngaphezulu ukuthi ihlulekile" ukuthi kungani kungenjalo.
m-09.s.s2.hint.0: Kwemikhiqizo engu-1000, hlukanisa imikhiqizo eyaphuma ingu-positive ibe ehlulekile nejwayelekile futhi ubale.
m-09.s.s2.hint.1: Phakathi kwalemikhiqizo engu-positive, bala ingxenye ehlulekile ngempela.
m-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Uhlukanise u-"ithuba lokuthi umkhiqizo ohlulekile ube ngu-positive" no-"ithuba lokuthi umkhiqizo ongu-positive uhlulekile" encazelweni yakho?
m-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Usho inani lemikhiqizo ejwayelekile eyaphuma ingu-positive?
m-09.s.s2.model.0: Imikhiqizo ehlulekile ingu-2% kuphela ekuqaleni, ngakho lokho kungu-20 kwabangu-1000. Kwabangu-980 abajwayelekile, u-5%, okungu-49, nabo baphuma bengu-positive. Kuma-positive angu-67, angu-18 ahlulekile ngempela, ngakho lingu-27% cishe.
m-09.s.s2.model.1: Noma umhloli engu-90%, kunemikhiqizo ejwayelekile eminingi kakhulu, ngakho kunemikhiqizo ejwayelekile kodwa engu-positive eminingi kunemikhiqizo ehlulekile futhi engu-positive. Ngakho okukodwa okungu-positive akwenzi u-90%.
m-09.s.s2.model.2: Imikhiqizo ehlulekile ayivamile kakhulu futhi imikhiqizo eminingi ijwayelekile, ngakho inani lemikhiqizo emakwe ngephutha ngu-positive noma ijwayelekile lingaba likhulu kunenani lama-positive ahlulekile ngempela. Ngakho noma kungu-positive, ithuba lokuhluleka aliphezulu.

m-01.title: Ukubheka isimangalo esithi "Ukuphindaphinda njalo kwenza kube kukhulu"
m-01.goal: Funda ukuthi izibonelo ezimbalwa azikwazi ukuqinisekisa "njalo," bese wakha izibonelo zakho eziphikisayo lapho umkhiqizo ungeyona enkulu kunenombolo yokuqala, bese usho ukuthi umkhiqizo uba mkhulu nini.
m-01.material: UMinji uthe, "Ukuphindaphinda kwenza izinto zibe zinkulu. 3×4=12 inkulu kuno-3, 5×2=10 inkulu kuno-5, futhi 7×6=42 inkulu kuno-7. Ngakho noma iyiphi inombolo oyiphindaphindayo, umphumela uhlala mkhulu kunenombolo oqale ngayo!"
m-01.thinking.0: Ukuhlola ukuthi isiphetho sijwayelekile ngokweqile yini noma ngabe kunezibonelo eziningi
m-01.thinking.2: Ukuthola izimo lapho isimangalo sisebenza khona
m-01.prereq.0: Ukuphindaphinda izinombolo eziphelele ngamadesimali (ibanga leBanga 5-6, isb. 8×0.5)
m-01.s.s1.prompt: Yimuphi umugqa wengxoxo kaMinji onzima ukuwukholelwa? Khetha umugqa owodwa.
m-01.s.s1.hint.0: Qala uhlole ukuthi ukubala ngakunye kwezintathu kulungile yini.
m-01.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala phansi izinombolo uMinji azifaka ngazo, 4, 2, no-6, eceleni komunye nomunye bese ubona ukuthi zinakho okufanayo yini.
m-01.s.s1.line.3: Ngakho noma iyiphi inombolo oyiphindaphindayo, umphumela uhlala mkhulu kunenombolo oqale ngayo.
m-01.s.s1.explain: Okubonayo kuncike emugqeni owukhethile. Uma ukhethe omunye wemigqa emithathu yokuqala: leyo migqa ilungile kokubili ekubaleni nasekuqhathaniseni. Inkinga akuyona "Ingabe izibonelo ziyalunga?" kodwa "Ungaya kuze kube ngakephi ngezibonelo ezimbalwa nje?" Umugqa wokugcina ungalungile. UMinji wabheka izibonelo ezintathu kuphela lapho izinombolo aphindaphinda ngazo, 4, 2, no-6, zonke ziwuhlobo olufanayo lwenombolo, bese esho "noma iyiphi inombolo oyiphindaphindayo, njalo." Noma kunezibonelo eziningi, uma kukhona uhlobo lwenombolo olungazange luhlolwe, "njalo" alukuqinisekiswa.
m-01.s.s2.prompt: Yenza izibonelo ezimbili ezinezinombolo zokuphindaphinda ezihlukile ezibonisa ukuthi isimangalo sikaMinji asilungile. Sebenzisa inombolo ephelele engu-1 noma ngaphezulu njengenombolo yokuqala nenombolo enkulu kuno-0 njengenombolo yokuphindaphinda (inombolo ephelele noma idesimali ayinankinga), futhi umkhiqizo akumele ube mkhulu kunenombolo yokuqala.
m-01.s.s2.hint.0: UMinji uhlole kuphela izinombolo zokuphindaphinda ezingu-4, 2, no-6. Khetha uhlobo lwenombolo olungakahlolwa bese uluphindaphinda ngenombolo yokuqala.
m-01.s.s2.hint.1: Zama ukushintsha inombolo yokuphindaphinda ngezindlela ezahlukene, uqhathanise umkhiqizo ngamunye nenombolo yokuqala, bese ufuna izimo lapho ungabi mkhulu.
m-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Inombolo yokuqala iyinombolo ephelele engu-1 noma ngaphezulu.
m-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Sicela usebenzise inombolo ephelele engu-1 noma ngaphezulu njengenombolo yokuqala.
m-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Sicela usebenzise inombolo enkulu kuno-0 njengenombolo yokuphindaphinda. (U-0 ushiyiwe kulomsebenzi.)
m-01.s.s2.ok.c3: Umkhiqizo awuzange ube mkhulu kunenombolo yokuqala. Isimangalo sikaMinji siyaphula.
m-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Umkhiqizo ube mkhulu. Uqhathanise nenombolo yokuqala.
m-01.s.s2.explain: Isibonelo, 8×0.5=4 mncane kuno-8, futhi 6×1=6 ulingana no-6. Kokubili yizimo lapho "ungabi mkhulu." Ngisho nesibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo siyanele ukuphula "njalo."
m-01.s.s3.prompt: Uma uphindaphinda inombolo yokuqala (inombolo enkulu kuno-0) ngenye inombolo, yisiphi isitatimende esichaza ngqo, ngaphandle kokushiya lutho, ukuthi umphumela uba mkhulu nini kunenombolo yokuqala?
m-01.s.s3.hint.0: Shintsha inombolo yokuphindaphinda ngezindlela ezahlukene bese wenza ithebula le-(inombolo yokuqala)×(inombolo yokuphindaphinda).
m-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ethebuleni, hlukanisa imigqa lapho umphumela mkhulu kunenombolo yokuqala nalapho ungeyona, bese ubheka ukuthi yini ehlukile ngezinombolo zokuphindaphinda.
m-01.s.s3.r.a: Uma inombolo yokuphindaphinda inkulu kuno-1, umphumela uba mkhulu; uma ingu-1, uhlala unjalo; uma iphakathi kuka-0 no-1, uba mncane. Lesi sinqumo sisho lowo mkhawulo ncamashi.
m-01.s.s3.r.b: Izinombolo eziphelele zihlanganisa u-1. Hlola ukuthi kwenzekani ku-8×1 futhi ungalungisa lesi sitatimende.
m-01.s.s3.r.c: Amanye amadesimali, njengo-1.5, makhulu kuno-1, futhi amanye, njengo-0.5, mancane. Ukuba yidesimali kuphela akunquli.
m-01.s.s3.r.d: Uma inkulu kuno-2, umphumela ngokuqinisekile uba mkhulu, kodwa nezinye izinombolo ezincane kuno-2, njengo-1.5, nazo zenza ube mkhulu. Lokhu akuhlanganisi zonke izimo lapho uba mkhulu.
m-01.s.s3.r.e: Noma inombolo yokuqala inkulu, ukuphindaphinda ngo-0.5 kuyenza ibe mncane. Inombolo yokuphindaphinda inquma ukuthi umphumela uba mkhulu yini.
m-01.s.s3.explain: Uma inombolo yokuphindaphinda inkulu kuno-1, umphumela uba mkhulu; uma ingu-1, uhlala unjalo; uma iphakathi kuka-0 no-1, uba mncane. Ngakho isitatimende esilungile akusona "Uhlala uba mkhulu" kodwa "Ukuphindaphinda ngenombolo enkulu kuno-1 kwenza kube kukhulu."
m-01.s.s4.prompt: Ungathanda ukutshela uMinji ini? Sebenzisa izibonelo (izinombolo) osanda kuzenza ukubhala ukuthi kungani engalungile nokuthi umphumela uba mkhulu nini.

m-01.s.s4.hint.1: Qala ngokusho "Minji, akusebenzi ezimweni ezinjena," bese wengeza ukuthi yiziphi izinombolo okumele uphindaphinde ngazo ukuze kube kukhulu.

m-10.title: Uma u-f'(a)=0, ingabe iyi-extremum?
m-10.goal: Sebenzisa idatha yokushintsha kophawu lwe-derivative njengobufakazi ukwahlulela isimangalo esithi "Uma u-f'(a)=0, iyi-extremum," wakhe isibonelo esiphikisayo, futhi usho isimo sokuthi ibe yi-extremum.
m-10.material:
UJihun wathi, "Kumsebenzi u-f, uma u-f'(a)=0, bese unayo i-extremum (i-maximum noma i-minimum) ku-x=a." Uhlole uphawu lwe-derivative u-f'(x) yemisebenzi emithathu eduze no-x=0.
Umsebenzi | f'(x) | f'(−1) | f'(−0.1) | f'(0) | f'(0.1) | f'(1)
f(x)=x² | 2x | − | − | 0 | + | +
f(x)=x³ | 3x² | + | + | 0 | + | +
f(x)=−x⁴ | −4x³ | + | + | 0 | − | −
(Okungu-+ nokungu-− ethebuleni yizimpawu zamanani e-derivative. Funda u-x², x³, no-−x⁴ ngokuthi "x squared," "x cubed," no-"negative x to the fourth.")
m-10.prereq.1: Uphawu lwe-derivative, ukukhula nokwehla, incazelo ye-maximum ne-minimum (izinga le-Calculus)
m-10.s.s1.prompt: Bheka ithebula futhi ukhethe yonke imisebenzi oyahlulela ukuthi inayo i-extremum (i-maximum noma i-minimum) ku-x=0.
m-10.s.s1.hint.0: Kumsebenzi ngamunye, qhathanisa izimpawu zika-f' ngakwesobunxele nakwesokudla luka-x=0.
m-10.s.s1.hint.1: Sebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi uma uphawu lushintsha, umsebenzi ushintsha usuka ekukhuleni uye ekwehleni (noma ngakolunye uhlangothi).
m-10.s.s1.r.a: Uma uphuthelwe u-x²: uphawu luka-f' lushintsha lusuka ku-− luye ku-+. Yindawo lapho umsebenzi usuka ekwehleni uye ekukhuleni, ngakho i-minimum.
m-10.s.s1.r.b: Uphawu luka-f'(x) lungu-+ ngaphambi nangemuva kuka-x=0. Uyakhula, umile okwesikhashana ku-0, bese ukhula futhi, ngakho akuyona i-extremum.
m-10.s.s1.r.c: Uma uphuthelwe u-−x⁴: uphawu luka-f' lushintsha lusuka ku-+ luye ku-−. Yindawo lapho umsebenzi usuka ekukhuleni uye ekwehleni, ngakho i-maximum.
m-10.s.s1.explain: Ku-x², uphawu luka-f' lushintsha lusuka ku-− luye ku-+, ngakho i-minimum, futhi ku-−x⁴, lushintsha lusuka ku-+ luye ku-−, ngakho i-maximum. Ku-x³, u-f'(0)=0 kodwa uphawu alushintshi, ngakho akuyona i-extremum.
m-10.s.s2.prompt: Siwuphi isahlulelo esifaneleke kakhulu mayelana nesimangalo sikaJihun "Uma u-f'(a)=0, bese kunayo i-extremum ku-x=a"?
m-10.s.s2.hint.0: Uma isimangalo sithi "njalo," cabanga ukuthi yini esenza siphuthe uma kunecala elilodwa kuphela.
m-10.s.s2.hint.1: Kumsebenzi ngamunye ethebuleni, qhathanisa izimpawu zika-f' ngaphambi nangemuva kuka-x=0 uma u-f'(0)=0.
m-10.s.s2.o.a: Siyiqiniso. Yonke imisebenzi emithathu ethebuleni inou-f'(0)=0, ngakho inayo i-extremum.
m-10.s.s2.r.a: Yonke imisebenzi emithathu inou-f'(0)=0, kodwa emibili kuphela inayo i-extremum. Hlola yonke imiphumela ethebuleni.
m-10.s.s2.o.b: Siphosile. Noma u-f'(0)=0, kukhona umsebenzi ethebuleni ongenayo i-extremum.
m-10.s.s2.r.b: Ubonise ngesibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo ukuthi u-"njalo" uphosile.
m-10.s.s2.o.c: Siyiqiniso. Imisebenzi emibili kwemithathu ethebuleni inayo i-extremum, ngakho isebenza kwabaningi.
m-10.s.s2.r.c: Isimangalo esithi "njalo" asiba yiqiniso ngoba sisebenza emacaleni amaningi. Bheka ukuthi likhona yini ngisho nelilodwa icala lapho lingasebenzi.
m-10.s.s2.o.d: Akunakwahlulelwa. Kunemisebenzi emithathu kuphela ethebuleni, ngakho kunzima ukunquma.
m-10.s.s2.r.d: Noma kunemisebenzi embalwa, uma kunesibonelo esiphikisayo esisodwa, ungahlulela u-"njalo" ukuthi uphosile. Bheka ukuthi isibonelo esiphikisayo sisethebuleni yini.
m-10.s.s2.explain: U-f(x)=x³ unou-f'(0)=0 kodwa akayona i-extremum, ngakho kuyisibonelo esiphikisayo. Isimangalo esithi "njalo siyasebenza" siba amanga ngesibonelo esiphikisayo esisodwa nje.
m-10.s.s3.prompt: Yenza imisebenzi emibili ye-cubic u-f(x)=ax³+bx²+cx+d (ama-coefficient aphelele) enamanani ahlukile ka-a, lapho u-f'(0)=0 kodwa akukho i-extremum ku-x=0.
m-10.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala u-f'(x) ngokuya nge-a, b, no-c, futhi uthole u-f'(0).
m-10.s.s3.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi kungani u-x³ ethebuleni ayiyona i-extremum (uphawu luka-f') nokuthi uhluka kanjani ku-x².
m-10.s.s3.ok.c1: Ungumsebenzi we-cubic futhi ama-coefficient angamanani aphelele.
m-10.s.s3.fail.c1: U-a kumele abe yinombolo ephelele engeyona u-0, futhi u-b, c, no-d kumele babe yizinombolo eziphelele.
m-10.s.s3.fail.c2: U-f'(0) akasiwo u-0. Faka u-x=0 ku-f'(x)=3ax²+2bx+c.
m-10.s.s3.ok.c3: U-f'(x)=3ax², ngakho uphawu alushintshi ngaphambi nangemuva kuka-x=0.
m-10.s.s3.fail.c3: Uphawu luka-f'(x) lushintsha ngaphambi nangemuva kuka-x=0, ngakho kwakheka i-extremum. Bheka uphawu eduze no-x=0 ku-f'(x)=x(3ax+2b).
m-10.s.s3.explain: U-f'(x)=3ax²+2bx+c, ngakho u-f'(0)=c. Uma u-c=0, bese u-f'(x)=x(3ax+2b), futhi uma u-b≠0, uphawu lushintsha eduze no-x=0 futhi kwakheka i-extremum. Uma u-b=0, bese u-f'(x)=3ax², ngakho uphawu lufana ngaphambi nangemuva kuka-x=0 futhi akuyona i-extremum.
m-10.s.s4.prompt: Ufuna ukulungisa isimangalo sikaJihun ngokufanele. Ku-"Uma u-f'(a)=0 no-______, bese inayo i-extremum ku-x=a," bhala isimo esingena esikhundleni esingenalutho.
m-10.s.s4.hint.0: Ku-x² no-−x⁴ (amacala angama-extrema) no-x³ (icala elingeyona), qhathanisa ukuthi uphawu luka-f' luhluka kanjani ngaphambi nangemuva kuka-x=0.
m-10.s.s4.hint.1: Bhala eceleni komunye nomunye izimpawu ngakwesobunxele nakwesokudla luka-x=0 ku-x² no-x³, futhi ubhale emshweni owodwa ukuthi yini ehlukile.
m-10.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Ubhale njengesimo esiqhathanisa ukhohlo nokudla luka-x=a?
m-10.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Isimo siyakhipha icala luka-x³, lapho u-f'(x)=0 ku-x=0 kodwa akuyona i-extremum?
m-10.s.s4.model.0: Uphawu luka-f'(x) lushintsha ngaphambi nangemuva kuka-x=a.
m-10.s.s4.model.1: Yicala lapho, ngakwesobunxele luka-x=a, liyakhula bese lishintsha lehla ngakwesokudla (noma okuphambene), okungukuthi, lapho ukukhula nokwehla kushintshana.
m-10.s.s4.model.2: Ngakwesobunxele nakwesokudla luka-x=a, u-f'(x) ushintsha usuka ku-+ uye ku-− noma usuka ku-− uye ku-+.
m-10.s.s4.model.3: U-f''(a)≠0. (Uma i-derivative yesibili ingeyona u-0, iyi-extremum.)
m-10.s.s4.modelNote.3: Lokhu yi-second derivative test. Siyisimo esanele kodwa hhayi isimo esidingekayo.

m-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe wawazi ukuthi uthatha ukuthi imali ikhuphuka ngezinga elingashintshi?
m-05.s.s3.model.0: Ku-10GB, i-A ingu-9000+1000×10=19000 won futhi i-B ingu-3000+1500×10=18000 won. Ngakho i-B ishibhile.

m-08.title: Thola bonke onxantathu abanomjikelezo ongu-12

m-08.material: Kunezinduku eziningana. Ufuna ukukhetha izinduku ezintathu uzisebenzise njengezinhlangothi ukwenza unxantathu. Ubude bezinduku bonke bungamanani aphelele (cm), futhi umjikelezo, isamba sobude obuthathu, ungu-12cm. Awuzisiki noma uzihlanganise.

m-08.thinking.2: Ukuchaza isizathu sokuthi uzitholile zonke ngaphandle kokushiya noma yiziphi
m-08.prereq.1: Izisekelo zezinganinginingi (ukuqhathanisa isamba sezinombolo ezimbili nenombolo eyodwa)

m-08.s.s1.hint.0: Beka induku ende kakhulu, 6cm, phansi, bese umisa ezinye izinduku ezimbili ezigcawini zombili ukuze zithinte.
m-08.s.s1.hint.1: Engeza ubude bezinye izinduku ezimbili bese uqhathanisa nenduku ende kakhulu.

m-08.s.s1.explain: Noma uhlanganisa izinduku ezimbili ezingu-3cm, ubude bungu-6cm, bufana nenduku engu-6cm. Izinduku ezimbili zilala ngokuhlaba phezu kwenduku engu-6cm futhi akukho vertex eyakhiwayo, ngakho akwenzi unxantathu.
m-08.s.s2.prompt: Thola futhi ufake onxantathu bonke abahlukile abanobude obuzungezile obungu-12cm lapho wonke ubude bezinhlangothi bungamanani aphelele. (Onxantathu abanezinhlangothi ezihleleke ngokuhlukile kuphela babalwa njengonxantathu ofanayo.)
